title: XAI-SDN: An Explainable Entropy-Guided Machine Learning Framework for Real-Time DDoS Detection in Software Defined Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.05701v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: One of the biggest risks faced by Software Defined Networks (SDN) is the Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack in which a compromised controller can make an entire network unusable. To address these challenges, we suggest an entropy-guided machine learning framework, called XAI-SDN, for real-time DDoS detection in SDN environments which is lightweight and explainable. The framework extends the flow features extracted by CICFlowMeter with eight Shannon entropy metrics obtained by an $\mathcal{O}(1)$ rolling algorithm and uses a Random Forest classifier with SHAP TreeExplainer for providing transparency at the prediction level. translated_title: XAI-SDN：一种用于软件定义网络中实时DDoS检测的可解释熵引导机器学习框架
translated_abstract: 软件定义网络（SDN）面临的最大风险之一是分布式拒绝服务（DDoS）攻击，其中被攻陷的控制器可能导致整个网络无法使用。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为XAI-SDN的熵引导机器学习框架，用于SDN环境中轻量级且可解释的实时DDoS检测。该框架将CICFlowMeter提取的流特征扩展了八个通过O(1)滚动算法获得的香农熵度量，并使用结合SHAP TreeExplainer的随机森林分类器在预测层面提供透明度。在固定的时间划分上，XAI-SDN在CIC-DDoS2019 SYN基准的全部359万条流上实现了99.9987%的准确率、99.9621%的宏平均F1分数和1.0000的AUC-ROC。在不使用SHAP的情况下，该流水线每条流仅需0.0165毫秒（每秒处理60,606条流），使用SHAP时为每条流0.5122毫秒（每秒处理1,953条流）。
tldr: 提出XAI-SDN框架，通过熵引导的机器学习与SHAP可解释性技术，在软件定义网络中实现了高精度、轻量级的实时DDoS攻击检测。
en_tdlr: XAI-SDN is an explainable, entropy-guided machine learning framework that achieves near-perfect, lightweight real-time DDoS detection in Software Defined Networks with prediction-level transparency via SHAP.
